meta.title: Kiln Yoga, small yoga classes above a bakery in Peckham
meta.description: Kiln Yoga is a small Peckham studio with 14 mats. Slow flow, yin, a 4 week beginners course and Saturday pregnancy yoga, taught by Mei and two other teachers.

rationale: Warm colour and serif headings retain the studio's character. The classes and Mei's personal note carry the page without repeating the mat count as a separate band or presenting an invented floor plan. The room link now points to its existing description in the hero.

props.headline: Yoga in a warm room above the bakery
props.sub: Kiln Yoga is a small studio in Peckham with 14 mats, a wooden floor and big windows. Mei and two other teachers run slow flow, yin, a beginners course and pregnancy yoga on Saturday mornings.

photo.subject: The studio room in morning light: wooden floor, big windows, a few mats laid out in a loose row, nobody posing for the camera

featured.name: Beginners course
featured.description: Four weeks in the same small group and the same room. You start from the very first pose and learn the basics at a speed that suits you, with at most 14 people on the mats.

photo.subject: A beginners group of four or five people on mats, one of them mid-stretch and laughing a little, teacher kneeling beside them

others.name: Slow flow
others.description: Movement linked to the breath, unhurried, with time to settle at the end.

others.name: Yin
others.description: Long, quiet holds on the floor. Bring a sleepy body.

others.name: Single class
others.description: Book one class and see how the room feels.

others.name: Class pass
others.description: A pass for regulars, to use whenever you come.

props.text: Come a few minutes early, pick any mat, and tell me before we start if something hurts today. The room is warm and you can take your time.

props.title: Who is at the front
props.text: I'm Mei and I teach most of the classes. With 14 mats I can see everyone in the room and remember what you told me last week. Two other teachers share the timetable with me, and we teach slow flow, yin, the beginners course and the Saturday pregnancy class.
props.signature: Mei, teacher and owner of Kiln Yoga

photo.subject: Mei sitting cross-legged on a mat in the studio, window light from the side, relaxed and looking at the camera

props.title: Find the room
props.address: First floor, above the bakery, Rye Lane, Peckham, London SE15
props.directions: The studio is up the stairs above the bakery. Follow the smell of bread.

entrance.subject: The street door next to the bakery window, with the studio's name on the buzzer panel, daytime
